sync.what: the clip: brushes in circles, the two-feel on D-flat, the felt's Dbmaj9(#11), the bowed vibes
the chip enters as the foot breaks the bezel: the Build compiles (pass 1: 4)
the step-out: F minor, on the beat, 0.29 s before the cut to 1.03; the walk, the ride, the Build (pass 2: 8)
the Build (pass 3: 12), through Gerg's "Which sentence?"; it gives way to Selbeep
the peak: C7(#9b13) under "It understands physics." (the chair melts: the SFX's three drips)
the push into 1.05: Fm9 on a swung and, 0.21 s before the cut (the felt's pedal holds it)
THE HOLD: the band holds on the freeze (the felt rings, the arco bass swells in on F); freeze_hit_F owns the beat
two weeks later: the re-entry, Abmaj9 on a swung and, 0.21 s before the cut to 1.06
the Build's WHOLE pass, in A-flat (the odometer's colour)
THUD 1 (outside): the Build stops dead mid-pass; the swing thins to the bass pedal (C)
THUD 2 (closer): the cello's tremolo C3 swells in over the pedal
Gerg, not looking up: the Build compiles under his line (4, 8, then 12), soft, over the pedal
THUD 3 (the top step): the viola's tremolo G3 + Db4 swell in (an open fifth and a flat nine)
the doors blow open: the Build stops dead; the pedal holds through the doors (no hit: the SFX's)
DESIGNED HIT: the knee's note 1, F2 (dry; a sub F1 under it) on the complaint's THUD: the pedal lets go
the knee's note 2: F3 (+ the chip's F4, duty 0.5), on a swung and, 0.17 s before the cut to 1.12
the knee's note 3: F4 (+ the chip's F5, duty 0.25), on the beat, 0.21 s before the cut to 1.13
DESIGNED HIT: the knee's note 4: F5 (+ the chip's F6, duty 0.125: the intro's own glint), on a swung and, 0.21 s before the cut: the SMASH TO INTRO; cut on the smash
the SMASH: the intro's first felt F5 lands on this bar line (the same 96 BPM grid)
